passive.name: Martial Poise
passive.description: Enter a movement command while winding up Kalista's basic attack or Pierce to lunge a short distance when she launches her attack.

spells.name: Pierce
spells.description: Kalista hurls a spear, dealing physical damage to the first target hit. If this kills the target, the spear continues onward, carrying any Rend stacks to the next target hit. Kalista can dash after using this Ability using Martial Poise.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Sentinel
spells.description: Passive: When Kalista and her Oathsworn both Attack the same target, she deals % max Health magic damage. This effect has a second Cooldown per target and a cap of to non-champions. Active: Kalista sends a ghost to patrol an area for three laps. Champions spotted are revealed for 4 seconds. This ability has 2 charges ( second refresh).
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation fallback effect values was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Rend
spells.description: Passive: Kalista's spears linger in their target for 4 seconds, stacking any number of times. Active: Kalista rips the spears from nearby enemies, dealing plus physical damage per spear beyond the first. Slows enemies hit by for seconds. If this Ability kills at least one target, its Cooldown is refreshed and it refunds Mana.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation NormalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Fate's Call
spells.description: Kalista puts her Oathsworn into Stasis and draws them to herself for up to 4 seconds. The Oathsworn can click to launch themselves, stopping at the first champion hit and Knocking Back all nearby enemies. If the Oathsworn hits a champion, they are placed at their maximum attack range from it.
spells.coverageNote: No champion damage packet is present for this cast.
